AI Video Editor GoPro — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release with cloud-based AI video editing for GoPro and action footage.
- Accepts uploads up to 500MB in MP4, MOV, LRV, AVI formats; trims shaky parts, adds transitions, and syncs cuts to the beat.
- Automatic setup/authentication with 100 free credits on first use.
- Supports prompt-based editing instructions and exports polished highlight videos in about 1-2 minutes.
- Built-in credit management, session state, and error handling for smooth user experience.
